'''Magmusk''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sulfunk]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Blastniff]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Magmusk has developed an aesthetic liking to the explosive. The smell might be a little much, but blasting away Zobos is an important step of the post-meal detox routine."

Magmusk is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Magmusk's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Blastniff]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

*Feed this Tatari to B quality.
*Use [[Island Gold Rush|Energy Drink]] x20,000
*Own 5 Fire [[Badge Dojo|Badges]].

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Camps without proper ventilation are not allowed to have two or more Magmusks.' - Camp Rules 101"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Magmusks tend to store energy on their backs in the form of steady flames. Otherwise, energy may erupt suddenly, and you'll have a moving combustion engine on your hands. A really stinky one, too."
